dataset_name: Inbox Agent Realistic Email Evaluation Dataset
description: 50 fictional emails for evaluating Inbox Agent classification and draft generation.

emails.subject: Login page shows an error
emails.body: I cannot sign in to our dashboard. After entering my password, the page displays a 500 error.

emails.subject: Reports are not loading
emails.body: The monthly reports page keeps spinning and never opens. I tried another browser but the issue remains.

emails.subject: CSV export fails
emails.body: When I export contacts to CSV, I receive a download failed message. Can you help me troubleshoot?

emails.subject: Password reset link expired
emails.body: I requested a password reset, but the link says it has expired even though I opened it immediately.

emails.subject: Dashboard displays incorrect totals
emails.body: The dashboard total is different from the number shown in the detailed records. Please advise how to investigate.

emails.subject: Cannot upload a profile image
emails.body: The upload button accepts the file but then shows an error. The image is a JPG under 2 MB.

emails.subject: Notifications stopped arriving
emails.body: Email notifications stopped arriving yesterday. I checked spam and confirmed the notification setting is enabled.

emails.subject: Mobile layout is broken
emails.body: On my phone, the save button is hidden behind the footer and I cannot save the form.

emails.subject: Integration returns an API error
emails.body: Our integration started returning HTTP 401 responses today. The token was working last week.

emails.subject: Duplicate records after import
emails.body: After importing our spreadsheet, several contacts appear twice. What is the safest way to resolve this?

emails.subject: Change my account email
emails.body: I need to update the email address associated with my account. Could you point me to the correct settings?

emails.subject: Feature appears unavailable
emails.body: I followed the help instructions, but the bulk-edit option is not visible in my account.

emails.subject: Application closes when saving
emails.body: The application closes when I click Save. I can reproduce it on two computers.

emails.subject: Slow page response
emails.body: The customer list takes around 30 seconds to load today. It usually opens in a few seconds.

emails.subject: Invoice download fails
emails.body: Clicking Download invoice gives me a blank page. I need the invoice for our records.

emails.subject: Pricing for a small team
emails.body: We are a team of six and are evaluating your service. Could you share the available plans and pricing?

emails.subject: Request for an annual quote
emails.body: Please provide an annual quote for 25 users, including any volume discounts and applicable taxes.

emails.subject: Question about renewal cost
emails.body: Our subscription renews next month. Will the renewal price be the same as our current contract?

emails.subject: Is there a free plan?
emails.body: I am testing options for a small nonprofit. Do you offer a free tier or a trial before payment?

emails.subject: Additional user charges
emails.body: How much does it cost to add five more users halfway through our billing period?

emails.subject: Invoice payment options
emails.body: Could you confirm which payment methods are accepted for subscription invoices?

emails.subject: Enterprise pricing discussion
emails.body: We need pricing for approximately 300 employees and would like to understand enterprise licensing.

emails.subject: Request for revised quotation
emails.body: Could you revise quotation Q-104 to include onboarding for two departments?

emails.subject: Cancellation and final bill
emails.body: If we cancel at the end of this month, will there be any additional fees on the final invoice?

emails.subject: Compare monthly and yearly plans
emails.body: Please explain the cost difference between monthly billing and paying for a full year upfront.

emails.subject: Interested in a product demo
emails.body: Our operations team is interested in your platform. Can we arrange a 30-minute demo next week?

emails.subject: Evaluating your solution
emails.body: We are comparing three vendors and would like to learn how your solution handles multi-team workflows.

emails.subject: Request for product brochure
emails.body: Could you send an overview of the product features and the main benefits for a growing business?

emails.subject: Planning a purchase
emails.body: We expect to select a vendor this quarter. What information do you need to prepare a proposal for us?

emails.subject: Partner enquiry
emails.body: Our consultancy works with small businesses and we would like to discuss a potential partnership.

emails.subject: Does your platform support our use case?
emails.body: We need to manage several regional teams with separate permissions. Is this something your product supports?

emails.subject: Follow-up after product demo
emails.body: Thank you for the demonstration. Could we schedule a follow-up to discuss implementation and onboarding?

emails.subject: Request for a trial account
emails.body: Our team would like to test the main features with sample data before making a purchase decision.

emails.subject: Information for procurement
emails.body: Please share the product overview and the details our procurement team should review before vendor approval.

emails.subject: Interested in upgrading
emails.body: We currently use the basic plan and want to explore the advanced features available in the higher-tier plan.

emails.subject: Schedule a discovery call
emails.body: Would your team be available for a discovery call on Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon?

emails.subject: Reschedule tomorrow's meeting
emails.body: I have a conflict tomorrow morning. Could we move our scheduled meeting to Thursday after 2 PM?

emails.subject: Confirm calendar invitation
emails.body: I received the calendar invite for Friday. Please confirm that the meeting is still planned for 11 AM.

emails.subject: Available appointment times
emails.body: Could you share your available time slots next week for a project discussion?

emails.subject: Agenda for our meeting
emails.body: Before our meeting, can we reserve time to discuss milestones, owners, and open risks?

emails.subject: Meeting link missing
emails.body: The calendar event does not include a video call link. Could you send the correct joining details?

emails.subject: Cancel today's appointment
emails.body: I need to cancel today's appointment due to an unexpected commitment. Please let me know if I should rebook.

emails.subject: Set up a project review
emails.body: Can we schedule a project review with the implementation team sometime early next week?

emails.subject: Confirming our time zone
emails.body: The invite says 3 PM, but I am in India Standard Time. Could you confirm the time zone for the meeting?

emails.subject: Request for a short call
emails.body: Would someone be available for a quick 15-minute call to clarify two points from our last discussion?

emails.subject: Thank you for the update
emails.body: Thanks for sharing the update. I will review it with my team and get back to you if we have questions.

emails.subject: New coordinator contact details
emails.body: Our project coordinator has changed. Please update your records to use coordinator@example.org for future correspondence.

emails.subject: Sharing the signed document
emails.body: I have attached the signed agreement for your records. Please confirm once it has been received.

emails.subject: Copy of the presentation
emails.body: Could you share the presentation from last week's workshop with the participants?

emails.subject: General question about your team
emails.body: Who would be the best person to contact about a possible collaboration with our organization?
